verdict.rationale: Aider's documented automation is a single-shot `--message` mode and a Python `Coder.run` API that each execute one instruction and exit or return. These are developer building blocks, not a first-party way to launch fleets of parallel autonomous agents that run for hours or days. The community 'navigator-mode' autonomy is a third-party add-on and is not an official capability, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can launch fleets of autonomous agents that work in parallel on different tasks for hours or days

citations.quote: It will do that one thing, apply the edits to the files and then exit.
